description: Read computed values from a session by defined name, cell or range: the way to check what a model's formulas return, e.g. after set_inputs. Pass names as defined names, cell refs ("B4", "Sheet1!B4") or ranges ("Sheet1!H2:H18", up to 2,000 cells, one entry per cell); omit names to read every defined name. Returns {values: {<name or ref>: {cell, type, value}}}; a cell holding an Excel error comes back with type "error" and its code, not as a tool failure, while a key that isn't a defined name or valid ref fails the call. Values only: for formula text use get_formula_range, and to see what feeds a value use trace_dependencies.

names.description: Defined names, cell refs or ranges to read, e.g. ["Revenue", "B4", "Sheet1!H2:H18"]

session_id.description: Session ID returned by create_session (list_sessions shows the open ones)
